claims.text: Mandapa is in Ubud, in Bali's cultural and spiritual heart, where the jungle meets the Ayung River.

findings.quote: Located in Bali's cultural and spiritual heart of Ubud where the lush jungle meets the Ayung River

claims.text: Each guest has a dedicated Patih, or butler.

findings.quote: the personalized attention of a dedicated Patih or butler

claims.text: The villas have private pools and forest, rice terrace or riverfront views.

findings.quote: Villas - Bali hotel rooms with large, private pools and Forest, Rice Terrace or Riverfront views

claims.text: Sawah Terrace Restaurant serves heritage dishes of the Indonesian archipelago.

findings.quote: Savor heritage dishes of the Indonesian archipelago at Sawah Terrace

claims.text: Dining Beyond offers private dining in corners of the property or at offsite locations.

findings.quote: Explore private corners within The Reserve or even offsite dining options, and design your own culinary adventure.
findings.note: Private corners on property or offsite.

claims.text: The riverfront spa has five treatment rooms, a yoga pavilion, a meditation temple, a vitality pool, saunas and relaxation areas.

findings.quote: in addition to its five treatment rooms, it features a yoga pavilion, meditation temple, vitality pool, 24-hour fitness center, saunas, and relaxation areas
findings.note: All listed elements present; riverfront spa stated in same sentence.

claims.text: Complimentary sunrise and sunset yoga is offered daily to hotel guests.

findings.quote: Complimentary sunrise and sunset yoga, daily (available exclusively for guests staying at the hotel)

claims.text: Mandapa Camp is a children's and family programme.

findings.quote: Tailored for children or the entire family to enjoy, activities at Mandapa Camp offer a chance to learn new skills

claims.text: Ayung River white-water rafting trips end at the Mandapa river pier.

findings.quote: The rafting concludes at the Mandapa river pier.
findings.note: Ayung River white-water rafting ends at pier.

claims.text: Guests can join a Full Moon blessing ceremony at the hotel's lava stone temple.

findings.quote: you can join a Full Moon blessing ceremony at the hotel's lava stone temple

claims.text: Kubu at Mandapa has a zero-waste dining philosophy and sources ingredients from within 100km.

findings.quote: Kubu celebrates a zero-waste dining philosophy, sourcing ingredients from within 100km.

claims.text: Ambar Ubud Bar is perched on a cliff and serves handcrafted cocktails and Japanese fusion food, with daily live jazz.

findings.quote: Perched high on a cliff, Ambar, meaning sky in Sanskrit, offers guests a relaxed setting for handcrafted cocktails and Japanese fusion gastronomy, with golden sunsets and daily live jazz music.

claims.text: The accommodations blend Balinese heritage with contemporary elegance, with design by Jeffrey Wilkes.

findings.quote: Mandapa features thoughtfully designed accommodations that blend Balinese heritage with contemporary elegance by Jeffrey Wilkes.

claims.text: The spa offers sessions with a local Balinese healer.

findings.quote: unique opportunities include a session with a local Balinese healer

claims.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists Mandapa in its Readers' Choice Awards in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2023, 2025 and 2026.

findings.note: Years match exactly on the Condé Nast Traveler page.

claims.text: Mandapa is in Sayan, a 15- to 45-minute drive from central Ubud depending on traffic.

findings.quote: Mandapa is located in Sayan, a 15- to 45-minute drive from the center of Ubud, depending on Bali's notorious traffic.

claims.text: The official rooms page lists no accessible rooms at the hotel.

findings.quote: No Accessible Rooms Available at this Hotel

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the secluded jungle location requires transfer time to beaches and other attractions.
